content: Cetirizine, also known by the brand name ZYRTEC-D 12 HOUR™, is administered as follows: For adults and children aged 12 years and older, the recommended dosage is one extended-release tablet taken twice daily. In patients with impaired renal function, specifically those with a creatinine clearance between 11 and 31 mL/min, or in patients undergoing hemodialysis with a creatinine clearance of less than 7 mL/min, the dosage should be adjusted to one tablet taken once daily. Similarly, for patients with hepatic impairment, the recommended dose is also one tablet taken once daily. ZYRTEC-D 12 HOUR™ Extended Release Tablets can be taken with or without food. The tablets must be swallowed whole and should not be broken or chewed.
